title: tack.yaml
description: Configuration for tack, which generates dependency wiring in plain Go.

prefix.description: Prepended to the interface name to form the generated function name, so prefix New and interface Service give NewService. Without a prefix or a suffix the name is the interface name, which needs an output name or a different output package.

suffix.description: Appended to the interface name to form the generated function name, so suffix State and interface Redis give RedisState, and RedisStateTest for its test double. It combines with prefix: NewRedisState.

test.description: Also generate a test double next to each constructor. An output can override this.

providers.description: Packages searched for providers, relative to the module root. Shared by every output.

targets.description: The interfaces to generate constructors for.

packagePath.description: A package directory relative to the module root. Absolute paths and paths that leave the module are rejected.

target.description: An interface whose methods each name a dependency by return type.

package.description: The package that holds the interface.

interface.description: The interface name. Every method must take no arguments and return one value.

output.description: What to generate. Defaults to one output next to the interface. Give several to build more than one implementation.

name.description: The constructor name. Defaults to the prefix, the interface name and the suffix, and it must not equal the interface name when the output is in the same package.

package.description: The package to write into. Defaults to the target's package, and the directory may not exist yet.

filename.description: The generated file name. Defaults to the lowercase interface name plus _gen.go.

provider.description: A package searched for providers before the global ones, to override a few dependencies and keep the rest shared.

test.description: Overrides the global test setting for this output.
